info.title: Factory API
info.description: Receives GitHub webhooks, accepts jobs and decisions from people, and answers status and timeline queries. Authority comes from the numeric GitHub id of the principal behind the token, mapped to the protected allowlist. A decision is recorded here and applied by the engine in the worker.

get.summary: The process is running. Never reads the database.
Every check passes: the schema is not behind the code, the policy is loaded and every port is acceptable to the profile.

post.summary: Stores a request as a RECEIVED job. Admission is the engine's decision.
post.description: Needs the requester designation. A repeat of the same Idempotency-Key with the same request finds the first job; the same key with a different request is a conflict.

200.description: The job this key made before.

get.summary: The jobs of the caller's tenant, newest first.
The status of a job and of its stage runs.
get.description: A job of another tenant and a job that does not exist have the same answer.

get.summary: The state transitions of a job with their reasons, and its audit records, in time order.
The specification draft a person is asked to approve: the commit that holds it, the head of the ledger and the facts of the approval window.
get.description: Gives the values an approve needs: head is the commit of the draft and evidence is the hash of the last ledger entry, both as they are now. The commit is the one the worker compares with. An approval is refused if the draft moved or a gate result arrived after the person read it. The text of the draft is untrusted: download it with getArtifact by artifact_sha256. Any designation of the tenant may read it, on the repositories its allowlist entry reaches. 503 when the API has no artifact root configured.

parameters.name: stage_run_id
parameters.description: A specification stage run of the job. Without it the newest one.

get.summary: The gate reports of a job: the gate, the outcome, the block code and the hash of each report.
get.description: Lists every gate report the engine wrote into the ledger of the job, oldest first, at most 200. A person who approves a pull request reads the evidence here, and downloads one report with getArtifact by report_sha256. Any designation of the tenant may read it, on the repositories its allowlist entry reaches. 503 when the API has no artifact root configured.

get.summary: One stored document of a job, for download.
get.description: The document is untrusted. It is served as an attachment, under text/plain; charset=utf-8 when the stages stored it as text or JSON and under application/octet-stream otherwise, never under the type it claims, with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. It must be linked to a stage run of the job in the path and indexed for the caller's tenant, or the answer is 404 (another tenant's document looks the same as no document). A document larger than 4 MiB is 413. Any designation of the tenant may read it, on the repositories its allowlist entry reaches.

parameters.name: sha256
parameters.description: 64 lower case hexadecimal digits, without sha256:.

Content-Disposition.description: attachment, with a file name the API makes.

post.summary: Records a decision of a person: approve, reject, rework, pause, resume, cancel, unblock, a decision on a new dependency (approve-dependency, approve-build-code), a decision on the project's own new build code (approve-project-build-code), or a decision about a translation warning (ack-translation-warning).
post.description: Approve, reject, rework and ack-translation-warning need the approver designation; pause, resume, cancel and unblock need the operator designation; approve-dependency needs the designation the action add_new_direct_dependency names and approve-build-code and approve-project-build-code the one approve_build_code names, a security approver (policies/approval.yaml, actions). The designation is read from the allowlist by the numeric GitHub id of the principal behind the token. The decision is recorded and acknowledged with 202; the engine applies it. A decision on a dependency names the package, the version and, to tell two packages of one name apart, the start of the checksum; the worker applies it only to a package that the blocked validation stage run waits for, and the policy engine decides again whether this person may decide on that package. Unblock lets a BLOCKED stage run go again once the cause is gone: it names the stage run and a reason and asserts no fact, because the engine reads for itself whether the block is cleared (a decision recorded for what the stage run waited for, or a capability re-probe that passes). Approve-project-build-code accepts one file of build code that the change itself adds (a build.rs, a procedural macro, build dependencies): it names the path and the start of the SHA-256 of the content, as the evidence of the blocked validation stage run lists them, and the decision counts for exactly that content, so an edited script needs a new decision. Ack-translation-warning records an approver's decision about one open warning of the documentation reviewer's rule translation-unfaithful: it names the approval stage run, the number of the warning (from 1, as the gate reports list them) and a reason; the engine reads the warnings and the manifest of the approval request from what the stage run stored, and an approve of that request counts only the decisions of the person who approves. There is no merge and no deployment.

post.summary: A GitHub delivery. Verified on the raw body before anything is parsed.
post.description: The signature is HMAC-SHA256 of the exact bytes received, in X-Hub-Signature-256, compared in constant time against every secret in the rotation window. Every failure of the checks is the same 401. After a valid signature every outcome is 202: a new delivery, a repeat, an unknown installation and an event the factory does not act on look the same.

bearerToken.description: An opaque token: sfat_ and 43 URL-safe characters. Stored only as a SHA-256 hash, with an audience, an expiry and a revocation time. It identifies a principal and grants no role.

githubSignature.name: X-Hub-Signature-256
githubSignature.description: sha256= and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 1 to 128 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : ~ -. A retry with the same key does not repeat the effect.

Unauthorized.description: No usable credential. One answer for every reason.

NotFound.description: No such route or object. Another tenant's object has this answer.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with a recorded one.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body is over the limit.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The content type is not application/json.

repository_id.description: A repository registered for the caller's tenant.

text.description: The request exactly as written. At most 200 KiB; no control character except line breaks and tabs.

source_ref.description: The issue the job is for, as owner/name#number. The repository must be the one named by repository_id. A job is for one issue: intake authorizes the person who labelled it and delivery links the pull request to it, so a submission without one is refused with a 400.

draft.description: Null until the stage run has kept a draft.

window_hours.description: How long a request for a decision stays good before the worker rejects it as expired.

approvable.description: True when the stage run waits for a person and holds a draft.

head.description: The value to give as head.

evidence.description: The value to give as evidence.

code.description: The block code of a BLOCKED report.

readable.description: False when the stored report could not be read or is not a gate report.

stage_run_id.description: Required for approve, reject, rework, unblock and ack-translation-warning. Optional for approve-dependency, approve-build-code and approve-project-build-code: without it the decision is for the blocked validation stage run of the job.

head.description: The pull request head the person saw: 40 or 64 hex characters. Required for approve.

evidence.description: The ledger digest the person read: sha256: and 64 hex characters. Required for approve.

target.description: The stage that gets new work. Required for rework.

reason.description: Why. Optional for approve, required for every other verb. For approve-dependency, approve-build-code, approve-project-build-code, ack-translation-warning and unblock it has 10 to 500 characters; for all but unblock it is redacted before the engine stores it.

package.description: The package name. Required for approve-dependency and approve-build-code, and refused for every other verb.

version.description: The version of the package, such as 1.2.3. Required for approve-dependency and approve-build-code, and refused for every other verb.

checksum.description: The start of the checksum of the package archive the person was shown: 12 to 64 lower case hexadecimal digits, with or without sha256:. Needed only when two awaited packages share a name and a version.

warning.description: The number of the translation warning, counted from 1. Required for ack-translation-warning, and refused for every other verb.

path.description: The path in the repository of a file of build code the change adds, as the evidence of the blocked validation stage run lists it. Required for approve-project-build-code, and refused for every other verb.

digest.description: The start of the SHA-256 of the content of that file in the head commit: 12 to 64 lower case hexadecimal digits, with or without sha256:. Required for approve-project-build-code, and refused for every other verb. A script that was edited after the person read it has another hash and is not covered.

applied.description: False: the engine has not applied it yet.
